mapper.select: select m.*, g.name groupName from member m left join `group` g on m.group_id = g.id where m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into member (username, password, name, group_id, gender, age, image, self_intro, number, pos) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{groupId}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{image}, #{selfIntro}, #{number}, #{pos})
